briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we held rather than forcing a buy, and left the 7 existing positions untouched to let stops/targets work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash available rather than investing it immediately, so you can act decisively when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, holding cash below the deployment threshold isn't wasted opportunity — it's discipline that avoids forcing weak trades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留現金而非立即全數投入，以便在真正出現強勁機會時能果斷出手。像今天這種市場方向不明的日子，持有低於部署門檻的現金並非浪費機會，而是避免勉強進場的紀律表現。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ unchanged and the S&P 500 up a marginal 0.1%. There was no dominant macro catalyst driving flows in either direction, consistent with a low-conviction, wait-and-see session. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off trigger, capital stayed on the sidelines rather than chasing marginal setups.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢大致持平，納斯達克指數幾乎沒有變動，標普500指數僅微升0.1%。市場缺乏明顯的宏觀觸發因素，資金並未明顯流向任何一方，反映出投資人觀望氣氛濃厚。在沒有強烈風險偏好訊號的情況下，資金選擇繼續持有現金，靜待更明確的進場時機。
